title: execution_reserve output
description: Reserve one execution before calling the provider: its unit price is held against every budget that applies, and you get an execution grant the provider redeems before it starts the work. A paid run waits for the provider's approval unless a standing approval covers it: the reservation is then awaiting_approval with no grant until run.approved (or read it with execution_reservation_get); the provider may ask you to pay it first (run.payment_needed, paid on the provider's own page). A retry with the same execution_id returns the same reservation.
